title: Two Work Packages of the same stage write the same story file for RWB-P1-E2008-APP
source: Work Package files _work/msr/wp/B-P1-08.md and _work/msr/wp/B2-P1-014.md (both list the same 'Write only' path 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-SVC-P1 rwb-source-data (Source data)/RWB P1 E2008 APP Payment matching with the missed payment event v1.md); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (one slice, id RWB-P1-E2008-APP, legacy RWB-E2-008); _work/msr/status.json (B-P1-08 and B2-P1-014 both RUNNING)
description: The plan carries one slice for legacy RWB-E2-008 on rwb-source-data, but two Work Packages of stage B are issued for it: B-P1-08, which lists RWB-P1-E2008-APP beside three other legacy keys with fanout 5, and B2-P1-014, which lists the same story alone with fanout 0. Both name the same story file and the same fragment path, and both were RUNNING at the same time, so whichever worker finishes last overwrites the other's file and the two registers (CG-B-P1-08-E2008-1 to -6 and CG-B2-P1-014-n) can cite the same missing value twice. The story file and the fragment present in the tree are the ones written by B-P1-08 and are complete; B2-P1-014 keeps them under root AGENTS.md rule 1 and registers no second copy of their six missing values. No story content is missing because of this; the risk is to the numbering of the Gap Register and the Assumption Register, which step D1 allocates.
evidence: B-P1-08.md 'Write only' block: RWB P1 E2008 APP ... v1.md and _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P1-E2008-APP.json; B2-P1-014.md 'Write only' block: the same two paths; status.json: B-P1-08 RUNNING (1 try) and B2-P1-014 RUNNING (1 try); split_plan.json: exactly one slice with id RWB-P1-E2008-APP; _work/msr/gaps/B-P1-08.jsonl holds CG-B-P1-08-E2008-1 to -6 and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P1-08.jsonl holds ASM-B-P1-08-E2008-1 to -6, which are the rows the story file cites.
proposed: Keep one Work Package per story slice in the plan generator: either drop B2-P1-014 for RWB-E2-008 or drop RWB-E2-008 from B-P1-08's fanout list. At step D1, number the six rows of CG-B-P1-08-E2008-1 to -6 once and do not allocate a second set for B2-P1-014; add a plan-uniqueness check to checks/run_all.py that fails when two WP 'Write only' blocks name the same file.
